meta.name: cran-extrachecks
meta.description: Prepare R packages for CRAN submission by checking for common ad-hoc requirements not caught by devtools::check(). Use when: (1) Preparing a package for first CRAN release, (2) Preparing a package update for CRAN resubmission, (3) Reviewing a package to ensure CRAN compliance, (4) Responding to CRAN reviewer feedback. Covers documentation requirements, DESCRIPTION field standards, URL validation, examples, and administrative requirements.

copy.tagline: 检查R包是否符合CRAN提交规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在准备R包首次或更新提交到CRAN。
